messages:
Aisha Khan: Putting up a short relnotes draft for compact-stream v1.2 rollforward. Need quick checks on examples + any hard blockers. Preview: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/relnotes/compact-stream-v1-2
Tom Becker: scanning. Heads up: our Go SDK snippet still references old DialOptions; should switch to client.New() pattern.
Priya Menon: thanks @Tom. I'll update the Go and Node examples in a follow-up PR. Can someone confirm the example output for node?
Ethan Shaw: Node example output changed slightly because we now include metadata.score on responses. Docs should show the new JSON shape.
Maya Li: small editorial request: please don't call it a "migration" in the top paragraph, use "upgrade guidance" instead — Marketing prefers that phrasing.
Aisha Khan: noted, will reword. Also adding a short "Known issue" item about mobile preview TOC wrapping on narrow screens.
Tom Becker: PR created: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4217 — updates Go/Node snippets and example response JSON.
doc-bot: PR 4217 created by @Tom Becker: updates SDK examples, adds example response schema, and adjusts heading language.
Priya Menon: added Go snippet here for copy: ```go
client, _ := docs.NewClient(os.Getenv("REDWOOD_KEY"))
resp, _ := client.ChatGenerate(ctx, docs.ChatRequest{Model: "redwood-kestrel", Input: "Explain the new token caching"})
fmt.Println(resp.OutputText)
```
Ethan Shaw: QA note: embedding exports from older models can have endianness differences in some Python builds; recommend `np.frombuffer(..., dtype=np.float32)` in the embed migration guide. I'll drop a one-liner in the migration doc.
Maya Li: Localization check: we need a short translatable string for the release headline (<60 chars). Suggest: "Compact streaming: faster short prompts". Thoughts?
Aisha Khan: good. Keep it tight. Also can we add a 1-sentence rollback instruction for Dedicated customers? Legal asked for a simple opt-out blurb.
Tom Becker: added rollback note to PR as a short paragraph and to the internal rollout checklist.
QA-Bot: Docs build OK. Staging preview link: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/relnotes/compact-stream-v1-2. Accessibility check: header anchors pass, but contrast flagged on the callout box.
Aisha Khan: thanks all — plan: merge after Tom's PR passes merge CI, then publish at 3pm PT with the short announcement copy. If anything else pops up, reply here.
